data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'N-M-T', meaning 'to be kind and generous'. In Islamic culture, Neimaat represents the spiritual quality of showing grace, kindness, and generosity to others, as emphasized in the teachings of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh). The name Neimaat carries the meaning “Grace, kindness, generosity” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Neimaat usually hope their child will grow to embody grace, kindness, generosity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
